subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: The day 26 March is observed as the Independence Day of Bangladesh. The day is marked by nationwide (a) ------- and pride. It begins with 31 gunshots, and floral (b) ------- are placed at the National Mausoleum in Savar to honour the martyrs of 1971. People from all walks of life join rallies and cultural events that recall the (c) ------- and bravery of the freedom fighters. A grand (d) ------- of the armed forces takes place near the National Parliament. In the evening, public buildings are decorated with colourful (e) ------- to celebrate the occasion. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) celebration; (b) wreaths; (c) sacrifice; (d) parade; (e) lights; ● ●
